lesson.meaning: Providing a lot of useful facts or details.
examples: The workshop on time management was very informative, giving us practical tips.
I found the article about the new software update to be quite informative.
Her presentation at the quarterly meeting was highly informative and well-researched.
The customer feedback session provided some very informative insights into what our clients need.
Can you recommend an informative book on financial planning for beginners?
lesson.memory_tip: Remember, 'informative' means something gives you good 'information' that helps you learn or understand.
